ideas.description: 10 slots at 10%. Close crosses above the prior 63-day high (or the beta gap opens within 3% of that high) while the 60-day beta is at least 0.3 below the 252-day beta, OBV(126) > 0.05, above the 200-day. Exit under the 200-day, or under the 50-day after 63 bars.

what_it_does.buy: ((close crosses above donchian_high(63) and beta(60) is below beta(252) − 0.3) or (beta(60) crosses below beta(252) − 0.3 and close is above donchian_high(63) × 0.97)) and obv_trend(126) is above 0.05 and close is above sma(200)
what_it_does.sell: close is below sma(200) or (held 63 days or more and close is below sma(50))
what_it_does.order: buys the most heavily traded names first
what_it_does.size: up to 10 stocks at 10% of the account each

indicators.label: donchian_high(63)
indicators.about: Highest high of the previous length bars (excludes today, for breakouts).

indicators.label: beta(60)
indicators.about: Rolling beta to SPY: sample cov(stock, SPY daily returns) / sample var(SPY) over length bars.

indicators.label: beta(252)
indicators.about: Rolling beta to SPY: sample cov(stock, SPY daily returns) / sample var(SPY) over length bars.

indicators.label: obv_trend(126)
indicators.about: On-balance volume over length bars as a share of all volume: +1 = every bar up, -1 = every bar down.

indicators.label: sma(50)
indicators.about: Simple moving average of close.

indicators.label: sma(200)
indicators.about: Simple moving average of close.
